current_prefix.title: Prefix Configuration
current_prefix.description: The current prefix on this server is **`{prefix}`**. Use this character before each command.

set_prefix.title: Prefix Updated
set_prefix.description: The prefix has been modified to **`{prefix}`**. Please ensure server members are informed to prevent errors when executing commands.

voice_not_connected.title: Not Connected to a Voice Channel
voice_not_connected.description: Playback cannot be started. You must join a voice channel first to allow connection.

unable_connect.title: Connection Error
unable_connect.description: It was not possible to connect to the voice channel. Please verify that the necessary permissions to join and speak are available.

already_playing.title: Active Player
already_playing.description: Audio is already playing in the channel {channel}. Changing channels is not possible while users are listening.

no_song_found.title: No Song Found
no_song_found.description: No results were found matching the requested search. Please provide a more specific title or enter a direct link.

added_to_queue.title: Song Added to Queue
added_to_queue.description:
**{title}**

Queue position: **{queue}**

The track has been successfully added to the list and will play in its respective turn.

playlist_added_to_queue.title: Playlist Added to Queue
playlist_added_to_queue.description:
**{title}**

Total songs in queue: **{queue}**

The playlist has been fully loaded and the tracks will play sequentially.

current_volume.title: Current Volume
current_volume.description: The playback volume is currently set to **{volume}%**.

invalid_volume.title: Invalid Volume
invalid_volume.description: The specified value is incorrect. You must provide an integer between **1** and **100**.

invalid_type.title: Unexpected Value
invalid_type.description: The argument provided is invalid. Please enter a number from 1 to 100 to adjust the volume.

set_volume.title: Volume Adjusted
set_volume.description: The volume has been successfully updated to **{volume}%**.

current_language.title: Language Configuration
current_language.description:
The current language for messages is **{language}**.

Available languages on this server: `{supported}`

not_supported.title: Unsupported Language
not_supported.description:
The language `{err}` is not available.

Please select a valid option from the following list: `{supported}`

set_language.title: Language Changed
set_language.description: From now on, responses and messages will be sent in **{language}**.
